title: Upgrade: v1.11.0
summary:
Overhauls PoW difficulty to use a step-based exponential system (1.25x per step) for gradual adjustment. Migrates subscription_reserve_percent and bridge_attestation_threshold to double precision.

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to v1.11.0 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
